title: Count the most common error messages in a log file
summary: Pick the lines that contain ERROR, take one field from each, count how often each value appears, and show the most frequent first. A long log becomes a short list of problems.

aliases.text: count most common errors in log
which error happens most in my log
top errors in log file linux
how many times each error appears in log
посчитать самые частые ошибки в логе

steps.explain: Count the ERROR lines first, so you know the total size of the problem. grep -c prints only the number of matching lines.

Count the most common values. grep keeps ERROR lines, awk prints field 4 (the component in brackets for this log layout), sort groups equal values, uniq -c counts them, sort -nr puts the biggest count first, head keeps 10.
steps.cmd: grep ' ERROR ' <LOG_FILE> | awk '{print $4}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | head -n 10
steps.expect: Lines such as '  37 [db]': the count first, then the value. Change the field number if your log has another layout.

steps.explain: Show the last few full error lines to see what the top values really say.
steps.expect: Full log lines with a timestamp, the word ERROR and the message.
